name: iam:PassRole + omics:CreateWorkflow + omics:StartRun
description: Create an AWS HealthOmics WDL workflow that exfiltrates the execution role's temporary credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket. The module starts a run passing an admin role via iam:PassRole, waits for completion, retrieves the exfiltrated credentials from S3, and uses them to attach AdministratorAccess to the starting user. HealthOmics tasks have network isolation from the public internet but retain S3 access.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass the target admin IAM execution role to the HealthOmics service
Read exfiltrated credentials from the attacker-controlled S3 bucket after the workflow completes

additional.description: Monitor run status and verify completion

admin: A role must exist that trusts omics.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
An attacker-controlled S3 bucket must be accessible from HealthOmics (execution role needs s3:PutObject)
A private ECR repository must contain a container image suitable for running AWS CLI commands (HealthOmics requires private ECR images)
lateral: A role must exist that trusts omics.amazonaws.com with elevated permissions
An attacker-controlled S3 bucket accessible from HealthOmics execution environment

references.title: IAM roles and policies for AWS HealthOmics

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the HealthOmics workflow run as the execution role

options.name: CONTAINER_URI
options.description: Private ECR image URI for the WDL task container (e.g., 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/aws-cli:latest). HealthOmics does not support public Docker Hub images.

options.name: EXFIL_BUCKET
options.description: Attacker-controlled S3 bucket for credential exfiltration. Auto-populated from attacker infra if not set. The execution role must have s3:PutObject on this bucket.

options.name: EXFIL_KEY
options.description: S3 object key for the exfiltrated credentials

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach AdministratorAccess to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for HealthOmics workflow deployment

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete the HealthOmics workflow and run after execution. Note: policy attachment is tracked separately via workspace cleanup.
